# featbit_project (Data Source)

Reads one FeatBit Project by its exact UUID.

The lookup scans the complete Project collection for the exact UUID. It fails
when no exact match exists and never selects a fuzzy or first result. Returned
Environments are canonical, non-owning observations; secret values and UI
settings are not exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_id" {
  description = "Exact FeatBit Project UUID."
  type        = string
}

data "featbit_project" "exact" {
  id = var.project_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Exact Project UUID.

### Read-Only

- `environments` (Attributes List) Canonical, non-owning observations of the Project environments. Secret values and settings are not exposed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `key` (String) Project key.
- `name` (String) Project display name.

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Environment description.
- `id` (String) Environment UUID.
- `key` (String) Environment key.
- `name` (String) Environment display name.
